title: User sphere-sphere contact with friction: stick and slip by data coordinates
author: Claude-JG
description: UserItemCreator.CreateSphereSphereContact refuses dynamicFriction other than 0, as friction needs the tangential state in data coordinates. Decided: the stick-slip state and the tangential displacement in the data node, updated by the post-Newton function, as ObjectContactSphereSphere does.
releaseNotes: UserItemCreator.CreateSphereSphereContact takes dynamicFriction and frictionProportionalZone: the friction of the built-in contact on rigid markers, stick and slip by the data node; test model symbolicUserContactFrictionTest.
